The '''1935–36 [[La Liga]]''' was the eighth edition of the Spanish national league, and the last one before the [[Spanish Civil War]]. The season started 10 November 1935, and finished 19 April 1936.

[[Athletic Bilbao]] achieved their fourth title. [[Hércules CF|Hércules]] and [[CA Osasuna|Osasuna]] made their debuts in La Liga.

==Relegation play-off==
After the [[Spanish Civil War]], [[Real Oviedo|Oviedo]] withdrew from the [[1939–40 La Liga]], so their place was decided to be occupied by the winner of a play-off between [[Atético Madrid|Athletic Madrid]], now Athletic Aviación, and [[CA Osasuna|Osasuna]]; the two last qualified teams in the previous season.

{{OneLegStart}}
{{OneLegResult|'''[[Atlético Madrid|Athletic Aviación]]'''||3–1|[[CA Osasuna|Osasuna]]|}}
|}
